title: DELTARUNE
description:
A parallel story to UNDERTALE where Kris, Susie and Ralsei explore mysterious Dark Worlds, solve puzzles, and fight or spare enemies in turn-based battles with real-time bullet-dodging.

Kris and Susie are pulled from everyday life into hidden Dark Worlds with their own rulers and conflicts. Ralsei becomes a key ally, explaining prophecies and helping the party navigate these unstable realms. Each chapter introduces a distinct setting, emotional tone and battle gimmick while deepening the larger mystery. The story balances comedy, melancholy, suspense and meta-narrative ideas that connect it to UNDERTALE while remaining its own work.
